lines.en: label nodokaspecial30p4:
scene nodokahotel1
: Here — a gift from me to you. See it not as a perverted gesture, but a token of apology for being overly assertive in regard to your coital status.
lines.zh: : 给——我送你们的礼物。别把它当成什么下流的表示，就当是我就你们的性事进展过于强势而赔罪的信物吧。

lines.en: : Our...what?
lines.zh: : 我们的……什么？

lines.en: After wandering around the city for a bit, we make our way back to the same hotel we typically visit for large gatherings like the Dorm Wars and Christmas.
lines.zh: 在城里闲逛了一会儿之后，我们回到了那家常去的酒店——像是宿舍战争和圣诞节之类的大型聚会，一般都在那儿办。

lines.en: Based on the reactions of Rin and Otoha, however, I don’t think they anticipated being in a room {i}without{/i} Nodoka present to annoy them.
lines.zh: 不过看 Rin 和 Otoha 的反应，她们大概没料到会住进一个{i}没有{/i} Nodoka 在旁边烦她们的房间。

lines.en: Nor did {i}I{/i} anticipate the two of us being alone together, which I’m pretty confident is what’s happening right now.
lines.zh: 我也没料到{i}我{/i}们俩会单独待在一起——而我相当肯定，现在就是这么回事。

lines.en: : What’s that? What are you handing us?
lines.zh: : 那是什么？你在递给我们什么？

lines.en: : The key to your room. Have fun and don’t stay up too late. Or do. I am not your guardian — just a lone entity a bit more invested in your personal affairs than you’d prefer.
lines.zh: : 你们房间的钥匙。玩得开心，别熬太晚。或者熬也行。我不是你们的监护人——只是一个对你们的私生活稍微上心了点的独行个体，仅此而已。

lines.en: : You...got a room for just...the two of us?
lines.zh: : 你……就给我们俩……开了个房间？

lines.en: : It only has one bed. I hope that’s okay.
lines.zh: : 里面只有一张床。希望你们不介意。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel3
: Of course there’s only one bed. I should have figured this out the moment you dragged Sensei along.
lines.zh: : 当然只有一张床。你拖着 Sensei 一起来的时候，我就该想到的。

lines.en: : But...if Otoha and I are supposed to sleep in the bed, where are you and Sensei going to sleep?
lines.zh: : 可是……如果我和 Otoha 睡这张床，你和 Sensei 睡哪儿？

lines.en: : In our own bed, in our own room. Pay attention.
lines.zh: : 睡我们自己的床，在我们自己的房间。认真听。

lines.en: : We’re right next door to you two. Which also means we’ll be listening {i}very{/i} closely to anything you two get up to in there.
lines.zh: : 我们就在你们隔壁。也就是说，你们俩在里面搞出什么动静，我们都会听得{i}很{/i}清楚。

lines.en: : Are...you sure you don’t want to stay in the same room as us and Sensei can sleep all by himself?
lines.zh: : 你……真的确定不想跟我们一起住，让 Sensei 自己一个人睡吗？

lines.en: : Getting cold feet, Rin? This could be your chance to finally take things to the next level.
lines.zh: : 临阵退缩了，Rin？这可是你终于把关系往前推一步的好机会。

lines.en: : Or ruin everything. Which is probably what is going to happen if I don’t have someone there to prevent me from exploding.
lines.zh: : 或者彻底搞砸。如果没人在场拦着我别爆炸，大概就会是这个结果。

lines.en: : As if Nodoka would {i}prevent{/i} anything. We both know that all she’d do in there is cheer on your demise.
lines.zh: : 说得好像 Nodoka 能{i}拦住{/i}什么似的。我们都知道，她在里面只会为你的覆灭欢呼助威。

lines.en: : Yeah, but she’d do it in that same irritating way she’s always doing things which would offset all of the hormones and distract me from the things I want to do to you.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可她会用她那种一贯讨人厌的方式来助威，正好能抵消掉我满身的荷尔蒙，让我不去想我想对你做的事。

lines.en: : I’m fine sleeping in the same room as you. All I ask is that Sensei comes along as well as the two of us are a package deal until tomorrow morning.
lines.zh: : 我跟你们睡一间房也没问题。我只要求 Sensei 也一起，因为在明天早上之前，我们俩是打包出售的。

lines.en: : Deal.
lines.zh: : 成交。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel4
: What? No deal. Don’t go deciding things like that without me.
lines.zh: : 什么？不成交。别不等我同意就擅自决定这种事。

lines.en: : Otoha, I don’t think you understand the gravity of the situation here. I am a time bomb waiting to detonate.
lines.zh: : Otoha，我觉得你不明白事态有多严重。我就是一个等着引爆的定时炸弹。

lines.en: : I understand that whatever that {i}gravity{/i} leads to would be better with just us rather than these two perverts. Also, there is no way I’d be able to fall asleep in a bed with four people. Just take the keycard, Rin.
lines.zh: : 我明白的是，无论那份“{i}严重{/i}”会通向什么，只有我们俩都比有这两个变态在场要好。再说了，一张床上躺四个人我绝对睡不着。把房卡拿了吧，Rin。

lines.en: : Are you {i}sure?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你{i}确定{/i}？

lines.en: scene nodokahotel5
: Yeah...it’s cool.
lines.zh: : 嗯……没事。

lines.en: : We’ve been dating for a while now. We should...take opportunities like this when they’re handed to us.
lines.zh: : 我们已经交往一段时间了。这种送到手边的机会，我们应该……把握住。

lines.en: : You’re 100%% sure?
: Yeah...it’s fine.
lines.zh: : 嗯……没事的。

lines.en: : You’re {i}1000%%{/i} sure?
: Rin, just take the card.
lines.zh: : Rin，把卡拿着。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel6
: {i}Thank you.{/i}
: Room 25. Enjoy.
lines.zh: : 25 号房。好好享受。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel7

Rin and Otoha scurry off to their room, leaving Nodoka and me to...do whatever the next step in Nodoka’s plan is. Assuming “waiting” counts as part of the plan as things seem mostly out of our hands now.
lines.zh: Rin 和 Otoha 快步走向自己的房间，留下 Nodoka 和我……去做她计划里的“下一步”。如果“等待”也算计划的一部分的话——毕竟现在事情大体已经不在我们手上了。

lines.en: : They grow up so quickly, don’t they? It appears that our nest is empty once more.
lines.zh: : 她们长得真快，不是吗？看来我们的巢又空了。

lines.en: : Mission complete?
lines.zh: : 任务完成？

lines.en: scene nodokahotel8
: Does this seem like a satisfactory ending to you? Nothing has even happened yet.
lines.zh: : 你觉得这就是个令人满意的结局了？还什么都没发生呢。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t say that. You just locked Otoha in a room with a self-proclaimed time bomb. Even if all they do is sit there, Rin is probably going to orgasm at least three times. Just take the win and call it a night.
lines.zh: : 我可不那么想。你刚把 Otoha 和一颗自称定时炸弹的东西锁进了一个房间。就算她们只是坐在那儿，Rin 大概也会高潮至少三次。收下这场胜利，今晚就到此为止吧。

lines.en: : {i}Call it a night?{/i} Don’t tell me that libido of yours vanishes when it’s needed the most?
lines.zh: : {i}到此为止{/i}？别告诉我，你的性欲偏偏在最需要它的时候消失了？

lines.en: : Is it needed? Or is this going to be one of those situations where you make me {i}think{/i} it’s needed only for me to find out moments later that it’s not?
lines.zh: : 需要吗？还是说，这又是那种你让我{i}以为{/i}“需要”、结果片刻之后我发现根本不需要的局面？

lines.en: : You all make me out to be far more evil and far more calculating than I actually am, Akira. Not {i}everything{/i} has to be part of some plan.
lines.zh: : 你们所有人都把我想得太邪恶、太工于心计了，Akira。不是{i}每件事{/i}都得是某个计划的一部分。

lines.en: : No, but it usually {i}is.{/i}
lines.zh: : 不，但通常{i}都是{/i}。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel9
: Well, {i}someone{/i} has to write the script. And, correct me if I’m wrong, but you’re opposed to that now, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 总得{i}有人{/i}写剧本吧。而且，要是我没说错的话，你现在是反对这个的，不是吗？

lines.en: : Our chamber awaits, Papa. If we delay any longer, I’m worried we might {i}miss{/i} something...
lines.zh: : 我们的房间在等着呢，爸爸。要是再拖下去，我怕我们会{i}错过{/i}什么……

lines.en: scene black
Nodoka turns around and walks down the same path Rin and Otoha followed just moments ago, not stopping until the two of us are outside Room 24.
lines.zh: Nodoka 转过身，沿着方才 Rin 和 Otoha 走过的同一条路走去，一直走到我们俩站在 24 号房门外才停下。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel10
She doesn’t bother turning the light on as we walk in.
lines.zh: 我们走进去时，她连灯都懒得开。

lines.en: I take that as the first sign of what’s to come while preparing for the foil to follow.
lines.zh: 我把这当作即将发生之事的第一个信号，同时准备迎接随之而来的那一层反衬。

lines.en: There can be no causation without manipulation. And nothing will ever happen if there is, for lack of a better term or any creativity whatsoever, no one to script it.
lines.zh: 没有操纵，就没有因果。而如果——姑且这么说，也想不出更妙的词了——没人来编写它，就什么都不会发生。

lines.en: I’ve followed her screenplay perfectly.
lines.zh: 我把她的剧本演得完美无缺。

lines.en: I let her drag me along...make an example of all that I am in front of hundreds of people...all for a goal {i}she{/i} has that I only partially care about.
lines.zh: 我任由她拖着我走……任由她在几百人面前把我的一切当例子示众……全都是为了一个我只是部分在乎的、属于{i}她{/i}的目标。

lines.en: But it’s the smallest part of all.
lines.zh: 但那只是其中最小的一部分。

lines.en: The truth is that I hate what is bound to happen next door.
lines.zh: 真相是，我讨厌隔壁注定要发生的那件事。

lines.en: I hate that I will be on {i}this{/i} side of the wall while a girl who reminds me too much of my ideal self chuckles at the thought that this is all because of her.
lines.zh: 我讨厌自己会待在墙的{i}这一侧{/i}，而一个让我想起理想自我的女孩，正窃笑着以为这一切都是她的功劳。

lines.en: I look down on her, but the hidden truth is that I’m looking up.
lines.zh: 我俯视她，但藏起来的真相是——我在仰望她。

lines.en: The hidden truth is that I’m drowning in envy watching someone sculpt a world in which they’ll never care.
lines.zh: 藏起来的真相是，我嫉妒得快要窒息，看着有人雕琢出一个她永远不会在意的世界。

lines.en: Not one where they just pretend not to.
lines.zh: 而不是那种只是假装不在意的世界。

lines.en: : Can you hear anything, Akira?
lines.zh: : 你能听见什么吗，Akira？

lines.en: : From the other side of the wall?
lines.zh: : 从墙的另一边？

lines.en: scene nodokahotel11
: Not yet...no.
lines.zh: : 还没有……没有。

lines.en: : I imagine they’re both quite nervous. It might take an hour or two before things really {i}kick off.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我想她们两个都很紧张。可能要过一两个小时，事情才会真正{i}开始{/i}。

lines.en: : Why...do you want this so badly in the first place? I don’t get it. It can’t {i}all{/i} be for just {i}research...{/i}can it?
lines.zh: : 为什么……你一开始就那么想要这事发生？我不明白。总不能{i}全都{/i}是为了{i}取材{/i}……对吧？

lines.en: : Why do the sands sing? Or the mountains moan?
lines.zh: : 沙子为什么会唱歌？山峦为什么会低吟？

lines.en: : No one knows.
lines.zh: : 没人知道。

lines.en: : It has something to do with vibrations. That much is certain. That is how sound {i}works{/i} of course.
lines.zh: : 这跟振动有关。这一点是确定的。声音本来就是这么{i}运作{/i}的。

lines.en: : But the melodies created by air alone could not possibly sound that...beautifully ominous, could they?
lines.zh: : 可单靠空气奏出的旋律，不可能听起来那么……美妙的不祥，对吧？

lines.en: : There is something else at play. Something we don’t understand.
lines.zh: : 还有别的东西在起作用。某种我们无法理解的东西。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel12
: Let me be the thing you can’t explain.
lines.zh: : 让我成为你无法解释的那个东西吧。

lines.en: : The one piece of reality that is so far detached from what is actually {i}real{/i} that it makes you question your place in all of this.
lines.zh: : 成为那块离{i}真{/i}实如此遥远的现实碎片，让你开始质疑自己在这一切中的位置。

lines.en: : All of...{i}what?{/i}
lines.zh: : 在一切……{i}什么{/i}之中？

lines.en: : Who knows?
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢？

lines.en: : Who {i}wants{/i} to know?
lines.zh: : 谁又{i}想{/i}知道呢？

lines.en: scene nodokahotel13
: You asked me earlier why I started writing. My response was to confuse you.
lines.zh: : 你先前问过我为什么开始写作。我的回答是为了把你弄糊涂。

lines.en: : And while the reasoning for that may have bordered somewhere between a want for you to {i}get it{/i} and the desire to {i}reflect,{/i} the truth is much simpler than that.
lines.zh: : 虽然那背后的原因，大概游走在“想让你{i}懂{/i}”和“想{i}映照{/i}自己”之间，但真相要简单得多。

lines.en: : There’s someone I know who loves books.
lines.zh: : 我认识一个人，她爱书。

lines.en: : For years and years, they were all she had.
lines.zh: : 年复一年，那些书就是她的全部。

lines.en: : Fiction was her favorite. And from a creaky chair in the middle of a mostly-empty living room, she’d throw herself into story after story because her world was far too drab.
lines.zh: : 她最喜欢虚构作品。在一间几乎空荡荡的客厅中央，她坐在那把嘎吱作响的椅子上，一头扎进一个又一个故事里，因为她的世界实在太单调乏味了。

lines.en: : More often than not, while waiting for the shelves to repopulate, she’d read the same things over and over.
lines.zh: : 更多的时候，在等着书架重新被填满的日子里，她会把同样的东西翻来覆去地读。

lines.en: : Taking them in. Memorizing them.
lines.zh: : 吸收它们。记住它们。

lines.en: : She’d read until her eyes dried up...skin cracking from the dryness of the air and the constant scratch of paper on her fingertips.
lines.zh: : 她会一直读到眼睛干涸——皮肤因为空气干燥、纸页不断刮擦指尖而裂开。

lines.en: : But all the while, even as it was slowly killing her, she continued to do what she loved. She continued to seek solace in the pages of books when there was no solace anywhere else to seek.
lines.zh: : 但即便如此，哪怕这正在慢慢杀死她，她依然继续做着她热爱的事。当别处再也找不到慰藉时，她继续在书页里寻求慰藉。

lines.en: scene house2
: She had several friends, each with their own vices and virtues, but they too were so busy with said vices that they seldom touched her hands.
lines.zh: : 她有几个朋友，各有各的恶习与美德，可他们也都被各自的恶习缠身，很少去碰她的手。

lines.en: : And no one knew how broken she was but the girl who would fill those shelves with new books.
lines.zh: : 除了那个往书架上摆新书的女孩，没人知道她有多破碎。

lines.en: : Strands of lavender-colored hair, decorating the spaces between words would be plucked up by those cracking fingers and lifted up under the warm light of dimming bulbs.
lines.zh: : 几缕薰衣草色的头发，散落在字里行间，会被那些开裂的手指拈起，在渐渐暗淡的温暖灯光下举起来端详。

lines.en: : She would observe them for hours when the words stopped making sense. And she loved that color more than life itself, but it meant little when life to her was nothing.
lines.zh: : 当文字不再有意义的时候，她会盯着它们看好几个小时。她爱那颜色胜过自己的生命，可当生命对她而言一文不值时，这份爱也就没什么意义了。

lines.en: scene house3
: Regardless, the days carried on.
lines.zh: : 无论如何，日子还是一天天过去。

lines.en: : And as they did, her fingers never healed. Her heart never wavered. And all that kept her sane were those same lavender hairs and those same recycled words.
lines.zh: : 而随着日子过去，她的手指从未愈合。她的心从未动摇。唯一让她保持清醒的，还是那几缕薰衣草色的头发和那些同样被反复咀嚼的词句。

lines.en: : The air was thick with pheromones...and the cracks in her skin would occasionally be filled by the slow, sexual absorption of her own fluids coating her own skin as she tied those hairs around her fingers.
lines.zh: : 空气里弥漫着浓重的费洛蒙……当她把那些头发缠在手指上时，皮肤上的裂缝，偶尔会被自己缓缓渗出的体液、以一种带着性意味的方式吸收填补。

lines.en: : She’d put them inside of her.
lines.zh: : 她会把它们放进自己体内。

lines.en: : She’d cum until she cried under those warm, dim lights — a communal blanket haphazardly draped over her, still keeping her upper body exposed because she was desperate to be seen.
lines.zh: : 她会高潮到哭出来，就在那些温暖而昏暗的灯光下——一条共用的毯子胡乱地搭在身上，上半身依旧裸露着，因为她拼命地想被人看见。

lines.en: : And she’d whisper the name of the one she loved the most under her breath, hoping that breathing would become too hard and that the girl would hear her and rush downstairs to {i}save{/i} her.
lines.zh: : 她会低声念出她最爱那个人的名字，盼着自己的呼吸变得困难，盼着那个女孩能听见，然后冲下楼来{i}救{/i}她。

lines.en: : But she never did.
lines.zh: : 可她从来没有来。

lines.en: : She was always too busy saving someone else.
lines.zh: : 她永远是忙着去救别人。

lines.en: scene house4
: {i}Yuko...Yuko...{/i}she moaned, tenderly plugging herself up with the metastasized aeons of repressed lust and a desire to be free! But freedom wasn’t possible! The world was already over!
lines.zh: : {i}Yuko……Yuko……{/i}她呻吟着，用那癌变了无数岁月的、被压抑的欲望，以及对自由的渴望，温柔地把自己填满！可自由是不可能的！世界早就完蛋了！

lines.en: : The scent of rotten flesh filled her nostrils with regret and shame! Why didn’t she know?! Why did it take so long to find out?!
lines.zh: : 腐肉的气味灌进她的鼻孔，满是悔恨与羞耻！她为什么不知道？！为什么过了这么久才发现？！

lines.en: : The screams, still fresh in her mind as the one in the second half of my uninspired moniker discovered the remains of the first half sodomized her eardrums! She was bleeding! But she couldn’t stop!
lines.zh: : 那尖叫在她脑海里依然鲜活——当那个占据我这个毫无灵气的名号后半部分的人，发现了前半部分的残骸时，尖叫强暴了她的耳膜！她在流血！可她停不下来！

lines.en: : Yuko! Come downstairs!
lines.zh: : Yuko！下楼来！

lines.en: : Repopulate the shelves!
lines.zh: : 把书架重新填满！

lines.en: : Put dinner on the table and your fist inside my mouth! Eat this long forgotten body and drink in the memories of when things were happier! When they were better than this!
lines.zh: : 把晚饭端上桌，把你的拳头塞进我嘴里！吃掉这具早已被遗忘的身体，畅饮那些日子更快乐时的回忆！那时的一切都比现在好！

lines.en: : There were games back then! We didn’t mind the lack of natural light! We didn’t mind this single blanket, now stained with piss and blood and the excretions of untapped resentment!
lines.zh: : 那时候还有游戏可玩！我们不介意没有自然光！我们不介意这条如今沾满尿液、鲜血和未消解的怨恨所分泌物的单薄毯子！

lines.en: scene nodokahotel14
: You asked me earlier why I started writing. My response was to confuse you.
lines.zh: : 你先前问过我为什么开始写作。我的回答是为了把你弄糊涂。

lines.en: : Now, all I’m doing is confusing myself.
lines.zh: : 而现在，我只是在把自己弄糊涂。

lines.en: : I write because I have to.
lines.zh: : 我写作，是因为我必须写。

lines.en: : Because I am gifted.
lines.zh: : 因为我有天赋。

lines.en: : It is not my fault others don’t understand this gift.
lines.zh: : 别人不理解这份天赋，不是我的错。

lines.en: : It just means I have to {i}make{/i} them.
lines.zh: : 那只是意味着，我必须{i}让{/i}他们理解。

lines.en: : You can’t make anyone do anything by just copying down the lives of others into a book.
lines.zh: : 光是把别人的生活抄进书里，你不可能让任何人做任何事。

lines.en: : You don’t think that’s {i}all{/i} I do, do you?
lines.zh: : 你不会以为我{i}只{/i}会这一招吧？

lines.en: : I’m no one trick pony, Akira. I write all sorts of things in all sorts of genres.
lines.zh: : 我可不是只会一招的小马，Akira。我写各种各样的东西，各种各样的题材。

lines.en: : It’s not my fault that the one people seem to be the most interested in is the one about a grown man having his way with little girls.
lines.zh: : 人们最感兴趣的偏偏是那本讲一个成年男人为所欲为地玩弄小女孩的书，这也不是我的错。

lines.en: : That’s just human nature, I suppose — obsessively curious and demonstrably sick.
lines.zh: : 我想这就是人性吧——病态地好奇，而且明显有病。

lines.en: : That thing about the girl you were just talking about...the one who liked to read...
lines.zh: : 你刚才说的那个女孩的事……那个喜欢看书的……

lines.en: : What about her?
lines.zh: : 她怎么了？

lines.en: : You started off by saying you knew someone like that, but...that was really just part of something you’re writing, right?
lines.zh: : 你开头说你认识这样的一个人，可……那其实只是你正在写的东西的一部分，对吧？

lines.en: scene nodokahotel15
: Is that what you think?
lines.zh: : 你是这么想的？

lines.en: : If I had to guess...yeah. That’s probably what I’d go with.
lines.zh: : 如果非要我猜……是啊。我大概会这么想。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : Well, that’s a fine interpretation.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这是个不错的解读。

lines.en: : But I’m hesitant to tell you the ending to a story that’s still playing out.
lines.zh: : 不过，我还不太想把一个仍在推进的故事的结局告诉你。

lines.en: : Especially when there’s another story I’m slightly more interested in at the moment.
lines.zh: : 更何况此刻我对另一个故事稍微更感兴趣一些。

lines.en: : You mean {i}my{/i} story.
lines.zh: : 你是指{i}我的{/i}故事。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel16
: It’s {i}my{/i} story too, Akira. It just focuses more on you as I’m better suited as a background character.
lines.zh: : 那也是{i}我的{/i}故事，Akira。只是更聚焦于你，因为我更适合当个背景角色。

lines.en: : Can you imagine an entire book about {i}me?{/i} I’m exhausted just thinking about it.
lines.zh: : 你能想象一整本都是关于{i}我{/i}的书吗？光是想想我就累了。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel17
scene nodokahotel18
: That doesn’t mean I don’t crave the spotlight every now and then...
lines.zh: : 这并不意味着我偶尔不渴望聚光灯……

lines.en: : And do you know what the quickest way for a background character to step into the spotlight is?
lines.zh: : 那么，你知道一个背景角色走到聚光灯下的最快方式是什么吗？

lines.en: : To...spend time with the protagonist.
lines.zh: : 和……主角待在一起。

lines.en: : Akira, this is a {i}smut{/i} novel.
lines.zh: : Akira，这可是一本{i}色情{/i}小说。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel19
: The answer is fucking him.
lines.zh: : 答案是操他。

lines.en: : You really are just doing this for your book, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你真的就只是为了你的书才做这些，对吧？

lines.en: scene nodokahotel20
: Ah! I’m shocked! You think a lady like {i}me{/i} would throw away her precious virginity for a {i}book?{/i} Sensei, how could you? That hurts.
lines.zh: : 啊！我好震惊！你觉得像{i}我{/i}这样的淑女，会为了一本{i}书{/i}而丢掉宝贵的处女之身吗？Sensei，您怎么能这么说？太伤人了。

lines.en: : There’s just...something weird about all of this.
lines.zh: : 只是……这一切都透着点古怪。

lines.en: : Between the maniacal, anecdotal rambling and the sudden proclamation that we’re going to have sex, you can’t blame me for not immediately understanding what’s going on here.
lines.zh: : 一边是疯子般的、絮絮叨叨的逸事，一边又突然宣布我们要上床——你不能怪我没法马上搞懂现在是什么状况。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel21
: Hmm...
: When you put it that way, you do make a good point.
lines.zh: : 被您这么一说，确实有道理。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel22
: So, how are we going to do this? I think I’d prefer to be totally nude for my first time.
lines.zh: : 那么，我们要怎么来？我想我的第一次还是全裸比较好。

lines.en: : Nodoka, come on.
lines.zh: : Nodoka，别这样。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel23
if nodokaspecial15p3 == True:
: What’s the matter? You’ve already put it in my mouth. This is barely any different.
lines.zh: : 怎么了？您都已经插进过我嘴里了。这跟那个也没什么区别。

lines.en: else:
: What’s the matter? We both want it. It’s not like I’m an unwilling participant.
lines.zh: : 怎么了？我们俩都想要。我又不是不情愿的参与者。

lines.en: : The {i}matter{/i} is that it feels like there’s more to this that you’re not telling me. And that even {i}if{/i} I want to have sex with you-
lines.zh: : {i}问题{/i}在于，我感觉你还有别的事没告诉我。而且，{i}就算{/i}我想和你上床——

lines.en: : Which you do.
lines.zh: : 您就是想。

lines.en: : Even {i}if{/i} I do, it feels...risky knowing that this could all be part of some kind of scheme.
lines.zh: : {i}就算{/i}我想，这也让人觉得……有风险，因为这一切都可能是什么阴谋的一部分。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel24
: I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel25
: I understand the rationale. And I don’t blame you for being skeptical of me based on prior experiences.
lines.zh: : 我理解您的想法。基于过往的经验，您不信任我，我也不怪您。

lines.en: : Until now, I’ve been content as an observer. And I was having plenty of fun watching you defile everyone else while I remained pure and chaste.
lines.zh: : 直到现在，我一直满足于当一个旁观者。看着您玷污其他所有人，而我自己保持纯洁无瑕，那已经够我乐的了。

lines.en: : But that was just me fooling myself — separating the art from the artist.
lines.zh: : 可那只是我在自欺欺人——把作品和作者分开看待。

lines.en: : Only those who have {i}seen{/i} a cat can draw one.
lines.zh: : 只有{i}见过{/i}猫的人，才画得出猫。

lines.en: : And while there are plenty of talented artists who could work off of one’s {i}description{/i} of a cat alone, touching one with your own hands...{i}feeling{/i} it and {i}understanding{/i} it...that would be easier. Yes?
lines.zh: : 虽然有才华的艺术家光凭别人对猫的{i}描述{/i}就能画出来，但用自己的双手去摸一摸……{i}感受{/i}它、{i}理解{/i}它……那样会更容易。对吧？

lines.en: : Why does it matter if this ends up in a book or not? Are we not allowed to feel things just because there are little clones of us jumping around between pages somewhere?
lines.zh: : 就算这一切最后被写进书里，又有什么关系？难道因为某处的书页间有一堆我们的小小复制品在蹦跶，我们就不被允许有感觉了吗？

lines.en: : It’s more that I struggle to believe you {i}feel{/i} anything.
lines.zh: : 更多的是，我很难相信你会有任何{i}感觉{/i}。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel26
: Oh.
: So {i}that’s{/i} the problem.
lines.zh: : 原来问题在{i}这{/i}里。

lines.en: : It’s not just {i}one{/i} problem. It’s a whole mix of problems, but all of those things revolve around me not being able to trust you.
lines.zh: : 不止{i}一个{/i}问题。是一大堆搅在一起的问题，但所有这些问题的核心都是——我没法信任你。

lines.en: : For all I know, you could be...recording this or something. It’s bad enough that you’re already publishing it. You’ve given me no reason to believe that this is a good idea.
lines.zh: : 说不定你正在……录这个什么的。你把这一切都出版了，这已经够糟的了。你没有任何理由让我相信这是个好主意。

lines.en: : I suppose I was unaware that you needed one.
lines.zh: : 我不知道您还需要一个理由。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel27
: Forgive me as I’m about to say several very rude things, but I can assure you they come from a place of love.
lines.zh: : 请原谅我接下来要说几句非常无礼的话，但我向您保证，它们出自爱。

lines.en: : I’ve written many characters like you before, but I’ve never had the gall to give any of them such a {i}ridiculous{/i} caveat.
lines.zh: : 我以前写过很多像您这样的角色，但我从没厚脸皮到给他们安上这么{i}荒谬{/i}的附加条件。

lines.en: : {i}You{/i} can’t trust {i}me?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}您{/i}无法信任{i}我{/i}？

lines.en: : What kind of moral paragon are you pretending to be?
lines.zh: : 您这是在假装自己是哪种道德楷模？

lines.en: : You’re an adult having sex with teenagers. Lots of them. Does adding ridiculous clauses like “I have to trust them” and “they need to have feelings” to that make you feel better about yourself?
lines.zh: : 您是个和青少年上床的成年人。很多个青少年。在这种事情上再附加“我必须信任她们”“她们必须有感情”这种荒唐条款，能让您自我感觉好一点吗？

lines.en: : You’re one to talk. You-
lines.zh: : 你倒说得出口。你——

lines.en: scene nodokahotel28
: I’m not trying to make you feel bad.
lines.zh: : 我不是想让您难受。

lines.en: : I said this was coming from a place of love, remember?
lines.zh: : 我说过了，这些话出自爱，记得吗？

lines.en: : The point I’m getting at is that it is {i}okay{/i} to be a horrible person with horrible vices and that things like that should be {i}embraced.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我想说的是，做一个有着可怕恶习的可怕之人，是{i}可以的{/i}，那样的事应该被{i}接纳{/i}。

lines.en: : What matters most is not what is right or what is wrong.
lines.zh: : 最重要的不是什么对、什么错。

lines.en: : What matters most is staying true to yourself because it is individuality that spins the gears of this planet, not {i}righteousness.{/i}
lines.zh: : 最重要的是忠于自己，因为推动这颗星球运转的是个体性，而不是{i}正义{/i}。

lines.en: : Be corrupt. Be immoral. Be the scum of the earth and indulge in the pleasures of the freshest, untouched skin because that is what matters to {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 堕落吧。不道德吧。做个人渣吧，沉溺于最新鲜、未被触碰过的肌肤带来的欢愉，因为那才是{i}您{/i}在乎的东西。

lines.en: : That’s a horrible, disgusting lesson and an even more disgusting mindset.
lines.zh: : 这是一堂可怕又恶心的课，更是一种恶心的心态。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel29
: I know...Isn’t it great?
lines.zh: : 我知道……是不是很棒？

lines.en: : No, it’s not...
lines.zh: : 不，一点也不……

lines.en: : It’s one thing to internalize thoughts like that and...hide them from everyone else, but to outright {i}say{/i} them and talk about how it’s {i}okay?{/i} That’s...
lines.zh: : 把这些想法藏在心里、不让别人知道是一回事，可你居然{i}直言不讳{/i}，还说这{i}没问题{/i}？那简直……

lines.en: : It’s not...
lines.zh: : 那不是……

lines.en: scene nodokahotel30
: {i}Embrace{/i} it.
lines.zh: : {i}接纳{/i}它。

lines.en: : Harness those feelings and give them to me.
lines.zh: : 驾驭这些感觉，把它们交给我。

lines.en: : Show me the {i}real{/i} you — not the facade who beds the rest.
lines.zh: : 让我看看{i}真正{/i}的您——不是那个和别人上床时的伪装。

lines.en: : I want something that no one else has. A part of you that you don’t {i}have{/i} to deny because I will accept it all.
lines.zh: : 我想要别人都没有的东西。您的一部分，您{i}不必{/i}否认的那一部分，因为我会全盘接受。

lines.en: : And as you feast upon my flesh, I want you to remember how disgusting you are and how the world would scorn you for the things you’re doing to me.
lines.zh: : 而当您享用我的血肉时，我要您记住自己有多恶心，记住这个世界会因为您对我做的事而唾弃您。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel31
: I like her.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢她。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel32
: She’s like me but less pretty.
lines.zh: : 她跟我很像，只是没我漂亮。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel30
: What do you say, Akira?
lines.zh: : 您觉得呢，Akira？

lines.en: : Would you like to write a new chapter with me?
lines.zh: : 您愿意和我一起写一个新的篇章吗？

lines.en: : Or will those pointless, fraudulent morals of yours spoil the mood once more?
lines.zh: : 还是说，您那些毫无意义、虚伪的道德，又要再一次败坏气氛？

lines.en: : Come here.
lines.zh: : 过来。
